subject: EOQ: Stage refresh & finance tally — 48h playbook
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ: Stage refresh & finance tally — 48h playbook

Team —

We’re inside the last 48 hours for the quarter close window. Quick, targeted asks so finance can lock numbers by EOD Tue (6/14, 5pm PT):

1) Update Salesforce stage to "Commit" only for deals with a signed PO or written confirmation from procurement within 48 hours.
2) Populate the attached EOQ_stage_tally_v3.xlsx (tab: OWNERSHIP) with: account name, ARR, close date, contract owner, signatory name/email, and any credit/discount applied.
3) Drop any HubSpot deal link in the "notes" column (I pasted a link to the primary file here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/eoq-templates).

If a deal is hanging on legal or procurement and you don’t have a clear sign-off timeline, mark it "HOLD" — we will not classify HOLDs as committed for tomorrow’s finance lock.

Attachments: EOQ_stage_tally_v3.xlsx (please upload one consolidated sheet per owner).

Callout: Priyom — Novus Analytics (DEAL-8963) needs PO confirmation; if you expect the PO before Tue 5pm PT, put it to Commit.

Thanks — short and efficient here. If anyone needs a 10-min sync, ping me and I’ll join.

David Kim
Head of Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ: Stage refresh & finance tally — 48h playbook

David —

Thanks, running through the list now. Quick status for the two deals I own: 

- Novus Analytics (DEAL-8963) — $450,000 ARR. Procurement emailed a redlined PO (attached: novus_po_draft.pdf) and legal is OK with the current terms. Novus told me they will return a signed PO by Tue 6/15 AM PT (they’re across a holiday but committed). I’ll put this to "Commit" only after I have the signed PDF in-hand; tentatively expecting that by Tue noon PT.

- Acme Retail — $120,000 ARR. Customer finance has a final question on invoicing cadence; they asked for a sample invoice and we sent it Friday. There’s a small credit request on their side; legal is reviewing. I’m leaving this as "HOLD" until finance confirms.

I updated my rows in EOQ_stage_tally_v3.xlsx and attached the PO draft for Novus. If Finance needs the signed PO to mark commit earlier, I’ll escalate to Alex Rivera to expedite.

Priyom
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

David / Priyom —

I updated my accounts in the tally and moved three smaller deals to Commit (all have signed SOWs). One question on recognition: for deals with extended onboarding discounts (we offered a first-quarter credit), do you want the discount surfaced in the "ARR" column or as a separate line? Finance needs the gross ARR and the applied credit separately to reconcile to revenue schedules.

I flagged Acme Retail as HOLD per Priyom’s note. Priyom — I can take point on confirming the invoice cadence with the buyer if you want me to loop in CX.

Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ: Stage refresh & finance tally — 48h playbook

Appreciate the quick updates. Two short clarifications before we lock tomorrow: 

- Marissa: please list gross ARR in the ARR column and the total credit in the "Discount/Credit" column (so finance can net for revenue schedules).
- Priyom: once you have the signed PO, upload the PDF to the "Signed POs" folder in the Drive link and change SFDC to "Commit". If it slips beyond Tue 5pm PT, it will roll into next quarter’s forecast.

I’m attaching the consolidated tally I built from everyone’s inputs (EOQ_stage_tally_v3.xlsx) so you can verify your rows. If there are any borderline items that you think we should escalate (legal terms, non-standard credits >10%), flag them with "ESCALATE_FIN" in column H and copy me. I’ll triage those immediately.

We’ll do a brief 10-min sync at 9:30 AM PT Tue if anything outstanding — otherwise I will run the finance lock at 5pm PT and share the final numbers.

Thanks all — let’s keep the commits gritty and truthful.

David Kim
Head of Finance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: EOQ_stage_tally_v3.xlsx (consolidated), novus_po_draft.pdf
